findings.evidence: world/reviews/fresh16-1.png (almost all green, only floating labels visible) vs fresh16-3.png
findings.suggestion: Raycast from the target to the camera and pull the camera in or lift it when occluded; fade or cut away tree crowns near the camera.
findings.what: Camera in follow mode can end up inside or against a tree crown/terrain, filling the view with flat green so no creature is visible. Creatures are also mostly hidden behind tree crowns (already on the todo list).

findings.evidence: 3 samples: frame p95 56.0 / 61.0 / 42.2 ms; render p95 52.5 / 52.4 / 34.4 ms. Screenshots also have a p95 of 6.5 s.
findings.suggestion: Cut the raster cost: fewer or merged props (245), cheaper shadows, lower render resolution. Add a quality fallback when p95 is above 33 ms. Have the header show the measured fps, not the target.
findings.what: Frame time is over budget. Median frame is 23-28 ms, but p95 is 42-61 ms, so it visibly stutters, while the header claims '30 fps'. Almost all of the time is in render (median 22-26 ms, p95 35-52 ms). Sim, panels and sync are small.

findings.suggestion: Clamp labels inside the viewport, lay them out to avoid overlap, hide labels for occluded creatures, and show only the nearest ones or the followed one at full size.
findings.what: Name labels overlap and clump (Pinchy/Marshmallow/Sniffsalot/Wibbles/Pickles) and clip at the edges (the 'es' and 'good hop' fragments at the left and top in fresh16-1.png). Labels float without any link to the creature they name, and some creatures are hidden behind trees.

findings.suggestion: Filter test messages out of the human inbox view, put the agent's internals in a collapsed section, and lift the contrast and size of the grey text.
findings.what: The side panel shows internal process state, not game content: 'review: needs_work…', 'asked to wrap up (budget running low), provider cannot take mid-turn messages', token counts, and test-generated messages ('UI test: a wish sent'). It is noisy and hard to read for a viewer. The grey small text has low contrast.
findings.where: right panel, Sprout / Messages to you

findings.evidence: fresh16-1.png vs fresh16-3.png taken ~16 s apart: scene differs only by camera
findings.suggestion: Give creatures visible activity (walking, interacting, speech bubbles) and put the current event in the header. Fix the night look so the 'daytime' value matches what is drawn.
findings.what: Nothing in the world is happening. The creatures stand still, 'watching' shows no events, and no minigame or goal is visible. The scene is also dull: the night/atmosphere work is only on the todo list and daytime is about 0.03-0.04, yet the view is brightly lit, so the day/night cycle is not apparent.

findings.suggestion: Reserve budget for fixes to the camera and frame time before adding features.
findings.what: The last session changed no game code (token budget used up), so there is nothing new to judge. The token budget is 2.97M of 3.0M, which blocks further work sessions.

summary: The island looks pleasant when the camera is good, but the camera sometimes sits inside a tree crown (a full screen of green), frame times miss the 33 ms budget at p95, and name labels pile up.
